description:
Four test files exist (records, distance, exercise-catalog, exercise-alternatives), all covering pure functions. rotationState has none, and it is the function most likely to break quietly: the rule that freeform sessions neither resume a day nor advance the rotation lives in two isNotNull(dayId) filters that nothing would catch the removal of.

The bulk of this ticket is the repo's first database-backed test setup, not the assertions. Sequenced before the multi-program work on purpose, so the rewrite has a net under it rather than tests written twice.
title: Test rotationState and freeform isolation
